padding.definition: padding = promised days - actual delivered day number (positive = early)

design.never_delivered: counted as late under every policy
design.coverage_note: ceil() of the predicted quantile is the integer promise; coverage reported both raw and ceil.

recommendation_rule: on the SELECTION period (Oct-2017..Mar-2018): shortest mean promise with late rate <= 7% (never-delivered = late) and recorded review change >= -0.05; else keep current
conversion_source: Fisher, Gallino & Xu (2019) J. Marketing Research 56(5): +1.45% sales per business day of faster ACTUAL delivery (US apparel, new DC). Not a promise-display experiment; transfer is an assumption. Break-even elasticities are reported instead of a benefit.
